name: MiniMax H3 Video Generation / QC / Selection
description: Generate each CURRENT GenerationSegment through MiniMax H3, persist every GenerationAttempt, run deterministic media QC, and require explicit human semantic selection before publishing GENERATED_VIDEO and GENERATION_SELECTION.
when_to_use: REPLICA has CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD, GENERATION_SEGMENTS and TARGET_ASSETS
when_not_to_use: Any production input is missing or STALE
The user is asking for final post-production rather than generation

steps.title: 生成视频候选
steps.description: Persist ProviderJob before each MiniMax H3 request and download every successful response to local artifact storage.

steps.title: 技术质检
steps.description: Re-probe local video, validate SHA/duration/video stream/size/codec, and keep attempts separate from formal artifacts.

steps.title: 人工视觉选片
steps.description: Expose only technical PASS attempts for explicit semantic review and selection; do not infer human visual acceptance from ffprobe.

provider_rules: ProviderJob must exist before every MiniMax H3 remote call
Use the current official H3 V2 asynchronous task contract
GenerationAttempt is never a formal Artifact and cannot enter Post directly
Download provider media locally before the remote URL expires and persist SHA256
Technical QC may validate media mechanics only; character/action/scene quality requires explicit user review
Only technical PASS attempts can be included in a Selection candidate
Retries are bounded to avoid uncontrolled paid generation
completion_criteria: Every GenerationSegment has a technical PASS attempt
Every remote call has ProviderJob provenance
Every selected media file is local and SHA/ffprobe verified
User explicitly accepts the semantic selection
GENERATED_VIDEO and GENERATION_SELECTION are published together with current input lineage
failure_policy: Provider missing or remote failure fails closed
Technical QC exhaustion fails the generation task
No formal selection before explicit user acceptance
